Technical purpose of product or process: Hilti HIT-HY 170 serves for safely securing threaded rods and post-installed rebar connections in cracked and uncracked concrete C20/25 to C50/60. HIT-HY170 is ETA approved for seismic C2 category for anchoring. Hilti HIT-HY170 is a component of the Hilti SAFEset concept. Hilti SAFEset is an approved system which makes anchor installation an easier, safer and faster process. It significantly improves the robustness of fastening and dramatically reduces the possibilities of error during installation. As part of SAFEset HIT-HY170 can be installed with approved Hilti Hollow Drill bits and vacuum cleaners that drill and clean the hole in one step for virtually dust-free installation. The use of Hilti HDE22 dispenser with the Volume Calculator App leads to no under or over fill, reducing underfilling related risks and minimizing mortar wastage. | |
General comment on data set: The declared product of HIT-HY 170 is a two component system. The resin component (component A) comprises a resin based on methacrylate as well as mineral and cementitious fillers. The curing agent component (component B) comprises peroxide hardener, water and mineral fillers. Mixing the two components A and B in the static mixer initiates the curing (hardening) reaction of both binder systems. During the curing phase, a very strong bond is formed between the organic and inorganic binder matrix. The hybrid system formed during cement and resin curing results in a crosslinked duromer with desired design properties (high bond strengths within a short curing time) and particular durability. Composite foils are used for the two component foil pack of HIT-HY170. This kind of packaging serves the following purposes: waste volume reduction, easy storage and transport, and less packaging material. Through legislation and increased public awareness users have increasingly become discerned towards the use of styrene and other highly volatile components with their resulting unpleasant odour and low flash point (flammability). The reaction resins used in all Hilti hybrid adhesives contain no styrene, are practically odourless and have a considerably higher flash point, i.e. higher than 100°C in comparison to 34° C for styrene based products. HIT-HY170 is a premium performance injectable hybrid mortar with approvals for rebar connections and heavy-duty anchoring. | |
Technology description including backgro: Most raw materials are sourced in Europe. The transport is exclusively by truck for the European raw materials, and by truck and by ship for the others. Chemical mortars are usually two-component systems consisting of a binder and a hardener. One of the base components of the binder is the reactive resin which in the case of HIT-HY 170 is produced in Kaufering. The resin production process is a chemical reaction of the corresponding educts to a basic resin with subsequent mixing of the basic resin with different reactive diluents to a reactive resin. This process is controlled and monitored by process control technology. The production of chemical mortars consists of a mixing process and a filling process of the respective single components (binder and hardener) and their subsequent union to a two-component system (packaging). Here as well process control technology is used to weigh and mix solid and liquid compounds according to the specification. In the next step both well-mixed components run through an automized filling line in which each of the processed masses is filled into a tubular foil bag. Finally the single components are combined in one packaging unit. The two-pack foil bags are packed into cardboard boxes and then finally shipped. The manufacturing plant of HIT-HY 170, Hilti GmbH Industriegesellschaft für Befestigungstechnik, Hiltistr. 6, 86916 Kaufering, Germany, is certified according to ISO 9001.
